source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

address: HIPAA, SOC 2 Type 2, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001 compliant

reading.body:
The EdgeConneX facility in Rancho Cordova publishes one physical figure: 28,500 square feet of technical space. No IT load in megawatts is published on the operator's spec page, so no rack or accelerator count can be derived from the operator's own data. Without a power figure, the campus cannot be placed on the capacity scale that determines AI workload potential, and any megawatt estimate would be fabricated rather than read from the source.

The four certifications qualify the campus to host regulated workloads. SOC 2 Type 2 attests to audited controls over security and availability. PCI DSS qualifies it for payment card data environments. HIPAA qualifies it for protected health information. ISO 27001 certifies a formal information security management system. Which tenants, if any, use those qualifications is not published.

In California context, this site is one of 103 facilities this site has mapped in the state, using OpenStreetMap as the source for that count. Of those 103, only five publish a megawatt figure on their operator spec pages, totaling 170 MW across those five. This campus ranks sixth by published megawatts, meaning it falls outside the five facilities that actually report a power number, which is consistent with no megawatt figure appearing in its published specifications. California's grid constraints are a known factor for AI infrastructure in the state, but nothing in this campus's published data speaks to its power allocation or interconnection status.
